notes: Covetous is greed in a dungeon, so the set is bones, webs and the treasure that killed their owners. Tiers climb from a skull to silver chests to the Golden Pylon, a gold-sheathed miniature tomb that is the showpiece. The skull-on-gold and dragon hoards are held by the Hot Zone pool and the Bullion Vault by the Minoc expedition.

entries.why: Dangling cobweb in the treasure vaults.
Chain, bracelet and ring on a gold heap.
Stack of silver ingots like a moneylender's bricks.
Chest of silver ingots, enough to buy a barony.
Silver strongbox with one flawless diamond.
Golden Pylon, a tomb sheathed in gold for a patient king.
